Time zone used in Nepal

UTC+05:45
Time zone
World map with the time zone highlighted
UTC offset
UTCUTC+05:45
Current time

UTC+05:45 [refresh]
Central meridian
86.25 degrees E

UTC+05:45 is an identifier for a time offset of 5 hours and 45 minutes ahead of Coordinated Universal Time. The Nepal Standard Time, used in Nepal is based on it.[1] It is one of only three time zones with a 45-minute offset from UTC.[n 1][2] Till 1956 Nepal followed UTC+05:30, same as Indian Standard Time and Sri Lanka Standard Time.[citation needed]

As standard time (year-round)

[edit]

Principal cities: Kathmandu, Pokhara, Biratnagar

South Asia

[edit]
  • Nepal – Nepal Standard Time has existed since 1 January 1986, when Nepal adopted the new time zone after they advanced their clocks by 15 minutes ahead of their previous time zone Indian Standard Time.[3]
